name: Side Kicks!
source:
Side Kicks: a newly established special investigation bureau within the Sakrada Police Force, located in California, designed to heighten the security of Sakrada City with their unique style of thinking and individual skill. Currently seeking additional members.

A city in California, USA — Sakrada. In recent years, the spread of a highly addictive drug, Ripcord, has been causing several issues in the sunny, quiet city located on the West Coast. In order to control cases like this, the Sakrada Police Force established a new organization — a special investigation bureau made up of members with unique styles of thinking and their idiosyncratic skills, known as the Side Kicks.

Chika, who has exceptional athletic talent.
Hibari, the profiler who possesses a way with words.
Shishiba, the quiet hacker prodigy.
Rico, gifted with photographic memory.
Tatewaki, the leader in charge of the four.

The special investigation bureau has become well-known in the city for its ground-breaking investigation methods that are unlike anything ever seen before.

One day, the heroine Inori is scouted as a new member of Side Kicks. The skill she possesses…is the mysterious ability of clairvoyant dreams.

[Edited from [url=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2017/03/04/side-kicks-introduction/]Rie's Otoge Blog[/url]]
translation:
Side Kicks：位于加利福尼亚州的萨克拉达警察部队内新成立的特别调查局，旨在以其独特的思维方式和个人技能来加强萨克拉达市的安全。目前正在寻找更多成员。

美国加利福尼亚州的一座城市——萨克拉达。近年来，一种高度成瘾的药物Ripcord的蔓延，在这座位于西海岸的阳光明媚、安静的城市中引发了一些问题。为了控制此类案件，萨克拉达警察部队成立了一个新组织——由思维独特、技能奇特的成员组成的特别调查局，被称为“侧踢”。

Chika，拥有非凡的运动天赋。
云雀，拥有言语能力的侧写师。
芝芝，安静的黑客神童。
Rico，拥有过目不忘的天赋。
立胁，负责四人的首领。

特别调查局因其前所未见的开创性调查方法而在该市闻名。

有一天，女主角祈被发掘成为Side Kicks的新成员。她所拥有的技能……是神秘的千里眼梦境能力。

[编辑自[url=https://riebakkari.wordpress.com/2017/03/04/side-kicks-introduction/]Rie的Otoge博客[/url]]
